$comment: Functions the agency harness serves to rogue syndicates. One row per function the executor actually implements - a row without a handler would make the capability gate lie. `function_name` must appear in a channel_capability's harness_tools; that table maps the name to the capability it implies. Paths in every function resolve under the mission's working directory and are refused outside it.

data.label: Read File
data.description: Read one text file under the working directory. Returns numbered lines; use offset and limit to page through large files. Read only files whose contents the task needs - names and counts come from LS and Glob.

path.description: File path, relative to the working directory

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return (default 400)

data.label: List Directory
data.description: List the entries of a directory under the working directory, one per line, directories marked with a trailing slash. Returns the exact entry count.

path.description: Directory path, relative to the working directory (default: the working directory itself)

data.label: Find Files
data.description: Find files whose paths match a glob pattern (e.g. '**/*.py'), searched under the working directory (.git directories are not walked). Returns matching paths and the exact match count.

path.description: Directory to search from, relative to the working directory (default: the working directory)

data.label: Search File Contents
data.description: Search inside file contents (not file names - use Glob for names) for a regular expression (Python re syntax) under the working directory (.git directories, binary files, and files over 2 MB are skipped). Returns path:line:text for each match and the exact match count.

path.description: File or directory to search, relative to the working directory (default: the working directory)

glob.description: Only search files whose name matches this glob (e.g. '*.py')
